question: How do workers bought only in round 1 (no media, no later buys) spread influence?
manifesto: 'Blend my hunches' over all four regions with TRUE hunches: voter-weighted mean of the four regions' true archetype means (x_playbook.ui_blend_raw formula, computed from Electorate.archetype_of_region and region sizes), then UI integer-percent rounding (ui_to_integer_simplex -> ui_percent_to_manifesto) = the vector the UI commits
workers: k bought in round 1 only, WorkerTiming(k, 'front', 'proportional') = largest-remainder split by region size; library pick rule R22 (uniform among non-zealot, non-worker voters with degree >= min_degree in that region); no media; game's own random streams (one game per world and k)

metric_definitions.touched: cumulative # voters with engine attempts counter > 0 after round t (>= 1 real conversion draw from a worker or convert; attempts += min(#spreading friends, cap - attempts), 0 for workers and zealots). Excludes workers and zealots. Round 0 = 0.
metric_definitions.converted: cumulative # distinct voters converted in rounds <= t (workers excluded). Round 0 = 0.
metric_definitions.E_pct: expected vote share in % = 100 x mean over voters of P(vote | v after round t) (WorldOutcome.share_trajectory; round 0 = before any action)
metric_definitions.regions_round_T: after round T: converted (touched) voters / region size; 'largest' = the largest region of each world (gets the most workers), 'other' = the other three pooled; by_size_rank: rank1 = largest region
metric_definitions.delta_E_pp_vs_k0_paired: per world: E_pct(k) - E_pct(k=0), same world (paired), mean ± 95% CI
